0022600200.text: The Bucks, at home, are 1-8 on the season (1-4 at home) and sit 5th in the Central, 5.5 games back and 15th in the East, while riding a five-game losing streak into their 10th game. The Celtics are 7-2 (5-0 at home) on a two-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East. Gary Trent Jr. is out with illness for Milwaukee, and Boston's Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with illness and is a game-time decision, after Boston won the last meeting 109-102 in Boston on November 4, 2026, leaving the Bucks trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series.
